csp.text: Heidar, leader of the Cult of Rimewind, advises Gendrin to order spells that temporarily halt the Thaw, plunging the continent back into winter, until he finds Phyrexian etchings in the keep's depths, goes mad, murders Gendrin and takes command.
The World Spell thaws the icy graves of the dead, but Heidar calls them to duty for a twisted cause, and he tells Haakon to dredge the lake at Tresserhorn for bones to build a new army.
He forces the sun into hiding, and Kaysa sends Juniper Order druids to reclaim Yavimaya's borders from his second winter.

At the Battle of Kjeldor he arrives with Phyrexian war machines reclaimed from the melting ice and attacks allies and enemies alike, giving Garza Zol reason to have him assassinated, and her assassins kill the mad Heidar.
